incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: p99 latency for /v1/streams (us-east-1) > 2.5s over last 5m — potential SLO breach. @oncall please respond.
Mira: I'm oncall, looking. grabbing p95/p99 and streaming stall counts now.
Raj: seeing a sustained IO pattern on gpu-pool-3, NVMe read/write bursts and high cgroup writeback. might be noisy neighbor.
Alex: any user-facing errors? logs?
Mira: quick metrics snapshot (5m window):
```
p95: 480ms
p99: 2.8s
streaming_stall_rate: 7.2%
gpu_util_pool3: 92%
nvme_iowait_pool3: 35%
noisy_top_tenant: tenant-acme-42 (1.2k active streams, ~250MB/s read)
```
Mira: digging into cgroups. listing tasks for pool: `cat /sys/fs/cgroup/io/gpu-pool-3/tasks`
Raj: autoscaler is currently paused on that pool due to quota warnings; unable to add capacity automatically. deploy-bot shows scale events blocked.
deploy-bot: autoscaler: scale_out blocked by quota on pool3 (reason: GPU quota exhausted).
Linh: suggested mitigations: 1) soft throttle tenant IO (lower io.weight), 2) evict long-lived streaming sessions for that tenant, 3) if needed, drain/migrate tenant to dedicated pool. recommend try 1 then 2.
Sophie: support: ACME (tenant-acme-42) has raised a ticket saying their chat preview is lagging. they're on shared pool — I will send a holding message after we have mitigation.
Raj: commands to apply (infra API):
```
# lower IO weight for tenant-acme-42
curl -s -XPOST http://infra.internal/api/tenants/tenant-acme-42/actions -d '{"action":"set_io_weight","value":100}'
# evict sessions older than 600s
curl -s -XPOST http://infra.internal/api/sessions/evict -d '{"tenant":"tenant-acme-42","min_age_sec":600}'
```
Mira: applying IO throttle now (calling infra).
Mira: infra returned 202 accepted for set_io_weight. monitoring metrics.
~30s later
Mira: new metrics: p95 320ms, p99 1.1s, streaming_stall_rate 2.3% — improvement but still above target for p99.
Raj: good reduction. still seeing NVMe tail spikes; suspect some long-running reads causing kernel writeback. continuing analysis.
Sophie: sent holding message to ACME: "We're investigating increased latency for streaming and have applied temporary throttles. We'll follow up with ETA for full remediation."
Raj: opened migration ticket INC-4578 to move tenant-acme-42 to dedicated queue for sustained load (assigned to platform/pse).
deploy-bot: host-evacuate job queued for node-23 to reduce contention.
Linh: I'll run fio on node-23 and check kernel cgroup knobs (blkio vs io controller differences). handing off to Alex for kernel-level troubleshooting and longer-term fix.
Alex: taking over troubleshooting for the next hour. running fio now and will check NVMe SMART + dmesg for driver queueing.
Mira: handing on-call to Alex. I'll keep watching dashboards for 30m and will escalate if regressions.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated (temporary throttle + session eviction). SLOs restored to within target window. Please file a postmortem and link any follow-ups (migration ticket INC-4578, perf dig by eng-runtime).
Mira: thanks team. follow-up actions: (1) run root-cause analysis on NVMe tails and cgroup config, (2) evaluate autoscaler quota flow so pools can scale when under pressure, (3) define hard QoS limits per tenant to avoid similar noisy neighbor.
Sophie: I'll coordinate customer follow-up with account and PSE.
Alex: noted. will post findings and attach fio logs.
Raj: +1 to postmortem. adding runbook step: immediate throttle -> evict -> migrate.
Mira: closing handoff, monitoring for 30m. :thumbsup:
